digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1, provider capability routing, bedrock integration
propositions: T1 (overlay-priorart criterion) declares web=true in routing registry but loses web-search capability on bedrock cutover because _anthropic_web_search_capabilities gates by provider-name prefix 'anthropic', excluding bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8
the capability withdrawal is silent: no warning is logged and provider_provenance.capabilities does not record web-search absence, making the degradation unobservable in signed verdicts

web-access decision must not gate on provider-name prefix shape; it must derive from model profile / capability registry membership (supported_native_tools), consistent with the epic's zero-exceptions rule

T1 must have web access on every provider including bedrock; where a provider offers server-side web-search natively it should be preferred, and where it does not rebar must supply access via local fallback
provider_provenance.capabilities.web_access must record the attachment outcome as 'native' | 'local' | 'off' so future silent withdrawals are impossible to miss
plan_review_T1.md must assert web access is guaranteed for T1, not hedge it as provider-dependent or optional, while retaining the anti-fabrication clause and naming fetched results untrusted data
